programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: Surviving Globalism

programme.title: What's My Car Worth?
programme.desc: 'S5/E10 - Power and Class'. Josh and Keith visit Barrett-Jackson and Josh takes a look at a 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS with the LS6 option.

programme.title: What's My Car Worth?
programme.desc: 'S5/E11 - The Pace Car'. Barrett-Jackson brings a '68 Ford Mustang GT with the 428 Cobra Jet option to the auction block. At Auctions America Keith and Josh find a 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Pace Car.

programme.title: What's My Car Worth?
programme.desc: 'S5/E12 - Post-War Wheels'. A Willys Jeepster starts things off for Keith at Auctions America, while Josh Nasar takes a '57 Chevrolet Bel Air for a spin.

programme.title: What's My Car Worth?
programme.desc: 'S5/E13 - The Boss Nine'. Auctions America offers a 1964 Chevrolet Impala SS with a 409 V8 and Keith and Josh can't resist taking a look.

programme.title: Colosseum: The Whole Story
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Marks Of Time'. Two thousand years after it was built, the Colosseum is in dire need of repair.

programme.title: Sagrada Familia: The Gaudi Revolution
programme.desc: Gaudi left us a spectacular work. And an unfinished creation: the Sagrada Familia. A huge, senseless cathedral project.

programme.title: The Mystery of the Cosquer Cave
programme.desc: In Southern France, a decorated cave lies 35 meters under sea level. Follow experts as they construct a replica of the cave to preserve its 30,000-year-old paintings.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Part 1: Rise of Civilization'. The Bronze Age arrived about 3000 BC in the region around the Mediterranean, the Aegean, Mesopotamia and Egypt. Explore the new societies and cities that emerged.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Part 2: Masters Of Trade'. Trade in luxury goods drive the commerce economies of the Bronze Age. The first super powers in history, Egypt and Mesopotamia, emerge and dominate the region.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Part 3: Conquest And Collapse'. What led to the collapse of the city-state entities and the end of the Bronze Age? Possibly a perfect storm of uncontrollable factors that are still being researched.

programme.title: Tech Toys

programme.title: Tech Toys

programme.title: Tech Toys

programme.title: Tech Toys

programme.title: Tech Toys
programme.desc: 'S7/E7 - Imagination in Motion'. The Vision 1789 biomethane hyper car, the Inmotion V11 electric unicycle, and the industrial strength Superstrata bicycle.

programme.title: Tech Toys
programme.desc: 'S7/E8 - Voltaic Power'. The ergonomic, electric Verge TS motorcycle, the self-balancing Bel & Bel Z Scooter, and the Unlimited Race Kit for skateboards

programme.title: Tech Toys
programme.desc: 'S7/E9 - What's Next'. Meet Carroll Shelby, who constructed one of the most innovative race cars of his time, experience the Super Snake, from Shelby American.

programme.title: Tech Toys

programme.title: Tech Toys
programme.desc: 'S7/E11 - The Next Wave'. The Bentley Bentayga Hybrid SUV, the electric DTRE Stella Dirt Bike, and the Fliteboard electric hydrofoil surfboard.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Christophe Rocancourt'. From an orphanage in a small town in France to the heart of the glitterati of Los Angeles and New York, Christophe Thierry Rocancourt is a legend on the imposter scene.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Matthew Cox'. Matthew Cox is an American former mortgage broker from Florida who made millions falsifying documents to make it appear that he owned the properties.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Jan Lewan'. Jan Lewandowski, known as Jan Lewan, is a Polish-American songwriter and polka band leader. Lewan's financial crimes were described as a 'classic Ponzi scheme'.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Frdric Bourdin'. Frdric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter the press has nicknamed 'The Chameleon'.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Shaun Greenhalgh'. Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger. Over a seventeen-year period, between 1989 and 2006, he produced a large number of forgeries in a variety of styles.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Helmut Kiener'. One of Germany's greatest con artists, Helmut Kiener tricked thousands of private investors and banks out of more than $300 million.
